newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate end down ahead of Fed meeting.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate end down ahead of Fed meeting.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates ended down 120 basis points at 17.30 percent on Monday, as foreign demand surfaced after news of stronger-than-expected GDP growth.
The decline in Mexican rates also came amid expectations of no change in U.S. interest rates as a result of a Federal Reserve policy-making meeting on Tuesday, dealers said.

"The market has ruled out a Fed tightening tomorrow, which revived U.S. markets and helped the domestic debt market, too," a fixed-income analyst said. "The GDP data also boosted confidence in Mexico."
